structure: Combined Grades K-4 document. Front matter then 'Disciplinary Standards At a Glance' tables: one table per strand (Civics, Economics, Geography, History) with columns Kindergarten, Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4 (table columns 2-6 = K-4; column 1 = component name shared by K-4) giving the title/theme and components per grade. A 'Grade Level Themes' table follows. Then KPE tables per strand and component: header cells (strand, standard C.1/E.1/G.1/H.1, component name, 'Knowledge and Skill Performance Expectations') apply to K-4, a grade header row lists Kindergarten, Grade 1 ... Grade 4, then KPE cells coded strand.standard.GRADE.number (e.g. C.1.K.1, H.1.3.4); grade = third part of the code. Teacher Notes and bullet lists are embedded inside KPE cell units, so those units are labeled standards.
